test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

In December 2018

P. caused a landslide that

Q. an eruption of the volcano Anak Krakatau

R. triggered a tsunami in the Sunda Strait (Indonesia)

S. and killed more than 400 people
solution:
The correct answer is **QPRS [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The correct order of the sentence is **“In December 2018 an eruption of the volcano Anak Krakatua caused a landslide that triggered a tsunami in the Sunda Strait (Indonesia) and killed more than 400 people.”**
 
• Rearranging the sentence** in other orders, **would render it** meaningless and wrong.**
